title: Unit Event — Step by Step! — Episode2 If I Focus On Idol Work

meta.Episode: Episode2 — If I Focus On Idol Work
meta.Event Outline: Minori has told her groupmates in MORE MORE JUMP! that she wants to switch to the credit-based course. This hasn't been an easy decision to make, but she's been supported by some special people.

rows.Line: Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Uhh, okay...
If I wanted to focus on being an idol, based on our schedule for this coming month...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, we're mostly working in the afternoon...
Which means I'll only be at school in the morning...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Sounds like you'll be working a lot.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Photo shoots and stuff don't usually take more than a day, but TV takes much more time since we need to meet with the production staff a lot beforehand...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, unless the scheduling lines up just right, I won't be able to go on the field trip or anything...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If we went with this schedule, I'd get to do that interview with “LoVE IDoL”. I was so sure that was never going to happen.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <“LoVE IDoL”?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it's a website that I browse through pretty often with info on every idol you can think of! They publish news articles and even post all their interviews!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, when we got an offer and I thought about us doing one of those interviews, it felt like something out of a dream...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we couldn't accept the offer. Haruka and I are supposed to be at school on the day they suggested, and Shizuku and Airi already had other work scheduled.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, that's too bad...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I would be able to do that interview if I followed this “full-time idol” schedule... If I were credit-based.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And looking at the schedule like this makes me realize just how much time I spend at school each day...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, I guess that's normal since we're in high school and studying is supposed to be our priority!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, I didn't realize going credit-based would free up so much of your time...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I see another schedule over here...
What's this one for?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that's our current schedule that Airi made!
She put it together to help us accept as many offers as we can.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I see...
It's packed from dawn until dusk. It's pretty incredible you're pulling this off...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But now I'm kinda worried about your health.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right...
We discussed as a group that we need to take care of our health, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think we're making Airi and Shizuku push themselves a bit since they're the ones working during the day while we're at school.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But going credit-based would free up a lot of my time and give me the flexibility to help them more, and we could accept more offers...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think I should go credit-based after all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our main goal right now is to get our name out there so that we'll be able to do a show at the Dome as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we need to be able to accept as many offers as we can. And if me switching to the credit-based course will allow us to do that, then that's what I should do.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Right...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My plan is to ask my teacher about this tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have so many questions. I need to know how I can get the material from any classes I miss, how tests will work, all of that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll try making a decision after hearing what they have to say...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I guess you're just the way you are, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
Is that a good thing or a bad thing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no! Look at the time!
I'm so sorry for keeping you this late, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Don't mind me.
I'm just glad you seem to be feeling a little better, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's because you helped, Len.
All the disorganized thoughts in my head came together thanks to you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll let you and the others know when I've come to a decision!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Thanks! I'll be looking forward to it!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I was going to tell Minori about what we discussed in SEKAI if she was worrying about her friends like Airi was...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But I see now that Minori's trying to find a way that she feels good about.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (So, I should probably refrain from saying too much...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Good luck, Minori.)
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you very much for discussing this with me!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
No, it was my pleasure.
Please feel free to drop by and ask more questions if you have any.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I talked to my teacher about going credit-based. I was given such a clear explanation...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But it's gonna be hard to get my homework done and stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I thought they'd have supplementary classes or something to make up for whatever I miss... But I just have to study on my own.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That makes sense, though. Even if they had supplementary classes, I might not be able to make them because of work. Plus, it'd be way too hard on the teachers if they had to teach us all one-on-one...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Which means... Everyone who's credit-based studies in between work appointments and stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Tests don't just go away either.
I have to plan for all that myself...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Th-That sounds really hard. Airi and Shizuku have been doing this the whole time? That's amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Haruka too. She went credit-based during junior high and only switched back to being a normal student recently...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She even said that she hardly ever got to participate in things like the Sports Festival and School Festival...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And if I go credit-based, I won't be able to either...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori? What are you mumbling about?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You literally ran out of class after it ended. We were wondering where you went, but I guess you just needed to visit the teachers' office...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's a lot of papers you've got there...
Did they ask you to carry them or something?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um... Th-These are...
se_event_step_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no!
M-My papers!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Geez, really...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A-Are you okay?!
Here, I'll help pick these up for... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Switching to the Credit-Based Course”...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uhh...
